results.name: unauthenticated page redirects to login and ledger BFF returns 401
genuine empty ledger is shown only after a successful zero-record response
simulation notice is visible and Start is disabled until acknowledged
PIN setup with wrong password is rejected, correct password succeeds
confirmed PKR 321 expense: receipt verified against ledger and PostgreSQL (32100 paisa, owner A)
reload keeps the persisted record visible
replaying the confirming request with the same event id returns the same receipt and creates no duplicate
ledger HTTP 500 shows an error (not empty), keeps last good records, and retry recovers
malformed 200 body is an error, never an empty ledger
network failure is an error and recovers on retry
delayed ledger visibility: verification retries until the row appears
tampered amount in the ledger response is flagged as a mismatch, not verified
receipt absent from ledger is reported as not yet visible, never verified
invalid inputs are rejected without ledger writes (bad PIN format, zero/negative/decimal/oversize amount)
ledger rows are append-only at the database layer
mobile viewport: no horizontal overflow and keyboard-only flow works
account switch: farmer B sees no records of farmer A and no cross-user DB rows
expired/revoked session: ledger refresh shows session-ended and clears records; sending is refused
